purpose: Find and fix capability and performance gaps before spending time on repeated benchmarking.
repeat_only_for: Explicit final validation after comparable coverage, source-checked quality and competitive speed/CPU/memory are demonstrated.
iteration: Run BulkParse on affected and regression inputs; reuse frozen competitor outputs unless their version or configuration changes.
quality: Do not count partial prefixes or nonempty output as complete extraction. No fabricated quality scores.
